newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IBM price target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IBM price target raised.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said analyst Daniel Mandresh raised his 12-month price target on shares of International Business Machines Corp to $150.
-- the analyst's previously published price target was $97-1/2 on a post-stock-split basis.
-- Mandresh said in a report that investor enthusiasm for IBM's prospects is growing.
-- said expected investors are poised to "significantly" expand the stock's price/earnings multiple.
-- "At current course and speed, IBM's PE could accelerate even further and we believe an 18 PE is possible on our 1998 EPS estimate of $8.25."
-- IBM is due to report second quarter earnings on Monday.
